local_context.value: Incorporated 1915, Polk County, elevation 135 ft; flatland with gently rolling hills; humid subtropical. Population 2,888 (2010) to 9,043 (2020); 3,739 housing units in 2020, mostly recent fast-growth stock. No official drainage or failure-pattern source found.

neighborhoods.value: PARTIAL, listing-site sources only (not official): ChampionsGate (master-planned, 11 subdivisions), Providence (gated golf), Solterra Resort, Highlands Reserve, Legacy Park. Whether ChampionsGate and Solterra are inside city limits was not checked.

place_entities.value: 1) Posner Park. 2) Davenport City Hall, 1 Allapaha St. 3) Horse Creek. 4) AdventHealth Heart of Florida (only hospital in the city). No Wikidata IDs checked.
